description: Retraining Shapley (PROJECT_PLAN.md §11.1, job J11; D24, D31), one seed. The frozen design is retrained on every non-empty coalition of the sensing players: F (force signal) and T (tool photos); usage is in every coalition and the empty coalition is B2. Players are only F and T (D24: tool photos only), so there are three coalitions: F, T, and F+T. F+T is the frozen design itself and is copied from gate3's outer fits (B1); F and T are trained here. Scores are validation-only until the freeze (D15); `rulfuse shapley` computes the values, and the test-tool values are read by `rulfuse final` on or after the freeze date.
